Olga/Ben — finance here. From an accounting control and audit perspective we prefer an invoice offset (contra-AR) recorded against the original invoice number. Practical reasons: it ties to the original AR ledger entry, reduces reconciliation drift, and avoids creating an additional refundable liability line. That said, we can issue a credit memo if sales/legal prefers — but we will need the following minimum metadata either way:

- Customer legal name (EdgeWave, inc.)
- Original invoice #: 2237
- Amount to credit (USD): $12,750
- Reason code: PoC uptime make-good (SOW section 4.3)
- Tax treatment: replicate original invoice tax lines (no VAT)
- GLA mapping: see attached GLA_mapping_edgewave.xlsx (we need destination GL accounts for contra-AR and revenue reversal)
- Required approver: Finance Director (Marcus Lin)

Also confirm whether EdgeWave needs a PDF credit memo for AP; we can generate one for their records after posting the offset. I'm attaching the GLA mapping template with suggested accounts. If customer is EU/has VAT we will follow tax reversal rules; please flag if that's the case.

Marcus Lin
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: GLA_mapping_edgewave.xlsx (xlsx, 9 KB)

- Finance will post the offset to the GLA accounts in GLA_mapping_edgewave.xlsx (attached) and provide a journal entry reference for your records.
- No VAT on the original invoice, so tax reversal is not required.

Next steps for EdgeWave: please confirm acceptance of the offset path so finance can post the entry and we can close the loop with a PDF copy of the credit memo. Once posted, we'll provide the journal reference and an itemized remittance note.

If you prefer a credit memo approach instead of the contra-AR, let us know within 24 hours and we can switch, though finance prefers the offset for reconciliation.
